title: Rawalpindi Campus, Rawalpindi | SMIT Campus Location & Details
text: SMIT Campus: Rawalpindi Campus, located in Rawalpindi, Pakistan. Address: S 25-A, 4th Road, Ashghal Mall Scheme, National Marketing, Near Steps College, Rawalpindi. This is one of Saylani Mass IT Training's (SMIT) training centers where free IT courses are delivered on-site. To check current course availability at this campus or enroll, visit https://www.saylanimit.com/enroll and select Rawalpindi as the city.
